qe:
Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for:
A remedy for all diseases
qh:
दिए गए शब्द समूह के लिए एक शब्द चुनिए:
A remedy for all diseases
e: 'Panacea' means a universal cure or solution for all difficulties or diseases.

qe:
Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for:
One who is indifferent to pleasure or pain
qh:
दिए गए शब्द समूह के लिए एक शब्द चुनिए:
One who is indifferent to pleasure or pain
e: A 'stoic' endures pain or hardship without showing feelings or complaining.

qe:
Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for:
A person who compiles a dictionary
qh:
दिए गए शब्द समूह के लिए एक शब्द चुनिए:
A person who compiles a dictionary
e: A 'lexicographer' writes or compiles dictionaries. A 'cartographer' draws maps.

qe:
Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for:
Incapable of being corrected or reformed
qh:
दिए गए शब्द समूह के लिए एक शब्द चुनिए:
Incapable of being corrected or reformed
e: 'Incorrigible' describes habits or people that cannot be corrected or improved.

qe: Choose the word closest in meaning (Synonym) to: PRUDENT
qh: दिए गए शब्द का समानार्थी (Synonym) चुनिए: PRUDENT
e: 'Prudent' means acting with care and good judgment for the future ('Wise').

qe: Choose the word closest in meaning (Synonym) to: ABUNDANT
qh: दिए गए शब्द का समानार्थी (Synonym) चुनिए: ABUNDANT
e: 'Abundant' means existing in large quantities ('Plentiful').

qe: Choose the word closest in meaning (Synonym) to: LUCID
qh: दिए गए शब्द का समानार्थी (Synonym) चुनिए: LUCID
e: 'Lucid' means expressed clearly and easy to understand.

qe: Choose the word opposite in meaning (Antonym) to: CONCEAL
qh: दिए गए शब्द का विलोम शब्द (Antonym) चुनिए: CONCEAL
e: 'Conceal' means to hide; 'Reveal' means to make known or show.

qe: Choose the word opposite in meaning (Antonym) to: HARMONY
qh: दिए गए शब्द का विलोम शब्द (Antonym) चुनिए: HARMONY
e: 'Harmony' means agreement or peaceful coexistence; 'Discord' means disagreement or strife.

qe: Choose the word opposite in meaning (Antonym) to: EXPAND
qh: दिए गए शब्द का विलोम शब्द (Antonym) चुनिए: EXPAND
e: 'Expand' means to become larger; 'Contract' means to shrink or become smaller.

qe:
Select the meaning of the idiom:
To beat about the bush
qh:
दिए गए मुहावरे का सही अर्थ चुनिए:
To beat about the bush
oe: To avoid coming to the main point
oh: To avoid coming to the main point
e: 'Beat about the bush' means to talk indirectly instead of addressing the main issue.

qe:
Select the meaning of the idiom:
Break the ice
qh:
दिए गए मुहावरे का सही अर्थ चुनिए:
Break the ice
oe: Make a situation comfortable by starting conversation
oh: Make a situation comfortable by starting conversation
e: 'Break the ice' means to initiate conversation and ease social awkwardness.

qe:
Select the meaning of the idiom:
At the eleventh hour
qh:
दिए गए मुहावरे का सही अर्थ चुनिए:
At the eleventh hour
e: 'At the eleventh hour' means at the latest possible moment before it is too late.

qe:
Fill in the blank:
She prefers tea ______ coffee in the evening.
qh:
रिक्त स्थान भरिए:
She prefers tea ______ coffee in the evening.
e: 'Prefer' takes the preposition 'to' when comparing two nouns.

qe:
Fill in the blank:
Walk carefully lest you ______ fall on the wet floor.
qh:
रिक्त स्थान भरिए:
Walk carefully lest you ______ fall on the wet floor.
e: 'Lest' is always followed by 'should' (or bare subjunctive), and never takes 'not'.

qe:
Fill in the blank:
The jury ______ divided in their opinions on the verdict.
qh:
रिक्त स्थान भरिए:
The jury ______ divided in their opinions on the verdict.
e: When a collective noun ('jury') acts as divided individuals ('their opinions'), a plural verb ('were') is used.

qe:
Fill in the blank:
Do not look ______ on the poor; always treat everyone with respect.
qh:
रिक्त स्थान भरिए:
Do not look ______ on the poor; always treat everyone with respect.
e: 'Look down on' means to regard someone as inferior.

qe:
Fill in the blank:
By next June, she ______ her master's degree.
qh:
रिक्त स्थान भरिए:
By next June, she ______ her master's degree.
e: 'By + future time' takes the Future Perfect tense ('will have completed').

qe:
Fill in the blank:
He prevented his younger brother ______ going near the river.
qh:
रिक्त स्थान भरिए:
He prevented his younger brother ______ going near the river.
e: 'Prevent' is followed by 'from + gerund (-ing)'.

qe:
Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error:
The teacher asked (A) / to the student (B) / why he was late. (C) / No error (D)
qh:
वाक्य के किस भाग में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है, पहचानिए:
The teacher asked (A) / to the student (B) / why he was late. (C) / No error (D)
e: The transitive verb 'asked' does not take 'to' before its object: 'asked the student'.

qe:
Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error:
Myself Rahul Verma (A) / and I live (B) / in Gaya. (C) / No error (D)
qh:
वाक्य के किस भाग में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है, पहचानिए:
Myself Rahul Verma (A) / and I live (B) / in Gaya. (C) / No error (D)
e: A reflexive pronoun ('Myself') cannot be used as the subject; use 'I am Rahul Verma'.

qe:
Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error:
Fifty kilometres (A) / are a long (B) / distance to walk. (C) / No error (D)
qh:
वाक्य के किस भाग में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है, पहचानिए:
Fifty kilometres (A) / are a long (B) / distance to walk. (C) / No error (D)
e: A specific distance treated as a whole unit takes a singular verb: 'is a long distance'.

qe:
Improve the bracketed part:
Hardly had I stepped out (than) it began to rain.
qh:
कोष्ठक में दिए गए भाग को सुधारिए:
Hardly had I stepped out (than) it began to rain.
e: 'Hardly' pairs with 'when', not 'than'.

qe:
Convert into Passive Voice:
Please help the needy.
qh:
दिए गए वाक्य को Passive Voice में बदलिए:
Please help the needy.
oe: You are requested to help the needy.
You ordered to help the needy.
oh: You are requested to help the needy.
You ordered to help the needy.
e: Imperative requests beginning with 'Please' convert to 'You are requested to + V1'.

qe:
Convert into Indirect Speech:
Sita said to me, "Where do you live?"
qh:
दिए गए वाक्य को Indirect Speech में बदलिए:
Sita said to me, "Where do you live?"
oe: Sita asked me where do I live.
Sita asked me where did I live.
Sita asked me where I lived.
Sita told me where I lived.
oh: Sita asked me where do I live.
Sita asked me where did I live.
Sita asked me where I lived.
Sita told me where I lived.
e: Wh-questions in indirect speech use assertive word order (subject before verb) and shift to past tense: 'where I lived'.

qe: Choose the word that is correctly spelt:
qh: वह शब्द चुनिए जिसकी वर्तनी शुद्ध है:
e: 'Occurrence' has double 'c', double 'r', and ends in '-ence'.

qe:
Read the passage and fill in blank (1):
Regular morning exercise keeps both the body and mind (1)____. Walking in fresh air improves blood circulation and (2)____ stress levels after a busy workday. Even thirty minutes of daily physical activity can significantly (3)____ overall health and prevent many (4)____ diseases.
qh:
गद्यांश को पढ़कर रिक्त स्थान (1) की पूर्ति कीजिए:
Regular morning exercise keeps both the body and mind (1)____. Walking in fresh air improves blood circulation and (2)____ stress levels after a busy workday. Even thirty minutes of daily physical activity can significantly (3)____ overall health and prevent many (4)____ diseases.
e: Exercise keeps body and mind 'active'.

qe:
Read the passage and fill in blank (2):
Regular morning exercise keeps both the body and mind (1)____. Walking in fresh air improves blood circulation and (2)____ stress levels after a busy workday. Even thirty minutes of daily physical activity can significantly (3)____ overall health and prevent many (4)____ diseases.
qh:
गद्यांश को पढ़कर रिक्त स्थान (2) की पूर्ति कीजिए:
Regular morning exercise keeps both the body and mind (1)____. Walking in fresh air improves blood circulation and (2)____ stress levels after a busy workday. Even thirty minutes of daily physical activity can significantly (3)____ overall health and prevent many (4)____ diseases.
e: Walking in fresh air 'reduces' stress levels.

qe:
Read the passage and fill in blank (3):
Regular morning exercise keeps both the body and mind (1)____. Walking in fresh air improves blood circulation and (2)____ stress levels after a busy workday. Even thirty minutes of daily physical activity can significantly (3)____ overall health and prevent many (4)____ diseases.
qh:
गद्यांश को पढ़कर रिक्त स्थान (3) की पूर्ति कीजिए:
Regular morning exercise keeps both the body and mind (1)____. Walking in fresh air improves blood circulation and (2)____ stress levels after a busy workday. Even thirty minutes of daily physical activity can significantly (3)____ overall health and prevent many (4)____ diseases.
e: 'Boost overall health' means to improve health.

qe:
Read the passage and fill in blank (4):
Regular morning exercise keeps both the body and mind (1)____. Walking in fresh air improves blood circulation and (2)____ stress levels after a busy workday. Even thirty minutes of daily physical activity can significantly (3)____ overall health and prevent many (4)____ diseases.
qh:
गद्यांश को पढ़कर रिक्त स्थान (4) की पूर्ति कीजिए:
Regular morning exercise keeps both the body and mind (1)____. Walking in fresh air improves blood circulation and (2)____ stress levels after a busy workday. Even thirty minutes of daily physical activity can significantly (3)____ overall health and prevent many (4)____ diseases.
e: 'Lifestyle diseases' (like diabetes or hypertension) are prevented by daily exercise.
